column1: # Sailing port registry: the game's boat-location varbit values (SAILING_BOAT_N_PORT)
# joined to this plugin's mooring tiles. GENERATED — regenerate when ports change. Port
# ids and map positions adapted from the 'Dude, Where's My Boat?' hub plugin
# (github.com/ArchRBX/wheresmyboat, BSD-2-Clause), joined by proximity (<=15 tiles, name
# fallback for offset map markers) to sailing-moorings.tsv land tiles. A port may span
# several moorings; the FIRST row per id is the primary (teleport landing) berth.
